描述_EN: this thin-walled cup was probably used to contain alcohol; its flower shape was derived from similar sasanian silver examples. by the beginning of the 7th century large quantities of silver pieces in exotic shapes and styles were imported along the silk road from iran and central asia to china. silver objects were not as highly coveted in china as in other ancient civilisations such as the roman or the parthian, but they became important luxury items for emperors and high-ranking officials during the tang dynasty (ad\618-960). chinese craftsmen often reproduced foreign shapes and also acquired new manufacturing techniques from central asian silversmiths who had settled in chinese urban centres beginning in the mid 7th century.
描述_ZN: this thin-walled cup was probably used to contain alcohol; its flower shape was derived from similar sasanian silver examples. 到7世纪初，大量具有异国情调和风格的银器沿着丝绸之路从伊朗和中亚进口到中国。 银器在中国并不像其他古代文明如罗马或帕提亚那样受到高度重视，但在唐朝（ad618-960），它们成为皇帝和高级官员的重要奢侈品。 中国的工匠们经常复制外国的形状，也从7世纪中叶开始在中国城市中心定居的中亚银匠那里获得新的制造技术。
